plants.name: Camellia sasanqua
plants.description: Glossy evergreen shrubs covered in silky, open-faced blooms with golden stamens at the center. Their petals soften the gray of midwinter, and they draw in early pollinators on mild days. The shrubs are popular in gardens, hedges and temple grounds.
plants.bloomingSeason: Autumn through early winter, typically October to January, with some cultivars lasting into January
plants.location: Gardens in Japan, the southeastern United States and other mild temperate regions of the Northern Hemisphere
plants.funFact: Camellia sasanqua is a close relative of the tea plant, Camellia sinensis. Its seeds are pressed to make camellia oil, which is used in cooking and in cosmetics.

plants.name: Hamamelis species
plants.description: Bare winter branches burst into clusters of spidery, ribbon-like petals that crinkle and curl like confetti. The flowers carry a spicy, sweet fragrance that drifts across frosty gardens. It is a welcome sight in the quietest part of the year.
plants.bloomingSeason: Mid to late winter, with most species flowering from January to March
plants.location: Temperate gardens and woodlands of Britain, Europe and North America
plants.funFact: Witch hazel flowers curl their petals tightly into little coils during hard frosts and unfurl again when the weather warms, which protects them through freezing nights.

plants.name: Corymbia ficifolia
plants.description: A compact eucalypt that turns into a blaze of color in summer. Huge clusters of fluffy, filament-covered flowers cover the crown. Nectar-seeking honeyeaters and bees swarm the blooms, and the tree is a favorite for streets and gardens.
plants.bloomingSeason: Summer into autumn, with flowering recorded from January to May and some in September
plants.location: Native to the southwest of Western Australia, and widely planted in cooler coastal southern Australia
plants.funFact: This tree is native to only a small patch of Western Australia near Walpole, yet it is now planted in cities across the world for its spectacular summer flowers.
